title: TS-2026-009: Insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH permitted root access
summary: Tailscale disclosed a security vulnerability in their SSH implementation where insecure argument handling could allow attackers to gain root access to affected systems. The vulnerability, affecting TS-2026-009, was found in Tailscale's SSH functionality and requires immediate patching.
problem_solved: Addresses a critical vulnerability that allowed privilege escalation to root through insecure argument handling in Tailscale SSH.
why_valuable: This security bulletin is critical for Tailscale users as it documents a high-severity vulnerability that could compromise entire systems, requiring immediate attention and patching.
